Section 17A.8, Code 2026, is amended by adding the 15 following new subsection: 16 NEW SUBSECTION . 11. a. Upon a vote of the majority of 17 its members, the administrative rules review committee may 18 delay the effective date of a rule for approval by the general 19 assembly, unless the rule is adopted under section 17A.5, 20 subsection 2, paragraph “b” . If the rule is adopted under 21 section 17A.5, subsection 2, paragraph “b” , the committee, 22 within thirty-five days of the publication of the rule in the 23 Iowa administrative bulletin and upon a vote of the majority 24 of its members, may suspend the applicability of the rule for 25 approval by the general assembly. The committee may delay the 26 effective date or suspend the applicability of a rule if it 27 determines any of the following: 28 (1) The rule lacks adequate statutory authority. 29 (2) The rule imposes costs, burdens, or mandates on the 30 private sector that are not justified by the regulatory 31 analysis required by section 17A.4A. 32 (3) The agency failed to comply with a requirement of this 33 chapter in its rulemaking process. 34 (4) The rule raises significant policy concerns that 35 -3- HF 2717.3680 (2) 91 je/ko 3/ 6 warrant review by the general assembly. 1 b. The committee shall refer the rule to the speaker of the 2 house of representatives and the president of the senate. The 3 referral shall be in writing and shall include the committee’s 4 specific determination under paragraph “a” , subparagraphs 5 (1) through (4), the committee’s findings regarding the 6 determination, and any other information the committee deems 7 appropriate. The committee shall make the referral within ten 8 days of the vote under paragraph “a” . The administrative code 9 editor shall publish the referral in the Iowa administrative 10 bulletin. 11 c. The rule shall not become effective or applicable unless 12 it is approved by the general assembly. A rule that is not 13 approved shall not become effective or applicable.
